Trier · District

Trier-Süd

South of the city center. Home to the Kaiserthermen, Barbarathermen, and the Basilica of St. Matthias.

UNESCOThermenPilgern
Trier-Süd 4 sights · 1 hotels
On the map Hotels in Trier-Süd

Trier-Süd is the Roman axis of the city: it contains the monumental Kaiserthermen (Imperial Baths), the older Barbarathermen further on, and at its southern edge the Basilica of St. Matthias, which holds the only apostle's tomb north of the Alps. Residential streets blend with ancient topography.
